review_locator: PMCID:PMC2740402, Structural Insights into the Interactions between Platelet Receptors and Fibrillar Collagen
primary_title: Identification of a major GpVI-binding locus in human type III collagen
decision_basis: The collagen-receptor review identifies a type-III collagen GPVI-binding locus and cites the primary peptide-mapping study as evidence for GPVI-dependent platelet adhesion and activation.
limitations_preserved: Preserve fibrillar/triple-helical collagen III and GPVI-dependent platelet context; the source maps collagen-derived peptides rather than a complete native fibril structure, with no CNS or SCI inference.

review_locator: PMID:21172874, The role of osteoclast-associated receptor in osteoimmunology; PMCID:PMC8912536, The Molecular Interaction of Collagen with Cell Receptors for Biological Function
primary_title: OSCAR is a collagen receptor that costimulates osteoclastogenesis in DAP12-deficient humans and mice
decision_basis: The OSCAR review identifies collagen as the receptor ligand and cites the primary study showing direct OSCAR-Fc binding to collagen I with receptor-specific blockade.
limitations_preserved: Direct collagen-I binding is supported in the OSCAR-Fc and cell-binding assays; preserve OSCAR/FcRgamma-DAP12 and osteoclast/myeloid context, without SCI inference.

decision_basis: The collagen-receptor reviews identify LAIR1 as an inhibitory collagen receptor and cite the primary low-affinity interaction study showing specific binding to collagen I.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC9362873, LILRB4, an immune checkpoint on myeloid cells; PMCID:PMC8912536, The Molecular Interaction of Collagen with Cell Receptors for Biological Function
primary_title: New assay to detect low-affinity interactions and characterization of leukocyte receptors for collagen including leukocyte-associated Ig-like receptor-1 (LAIR-1)
decision_basis: The LILRB4 review establishes the inhibitory myeloid-receptor context, while the cited collagen-receptor primary study directly tests and reports collagen-I binding by mouse Lilrb4/Gp49B; the exact binding result is retained as the promotion basis.
limitations_preserved: Low-affinity mouse Gp49B/Lilrb4 binding is supported by the purified assay; preserve species/orthology and inhibitory-ITIM context, with no human-equivalence or SCI inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC11105017, Cellular uptake of collagens and implications for immune cell regulation in disease
primary_title: M2-like macrophages are responsible for collagen degradation through a mannose receptor-mediated pathway
decision_basis: The collagen-uptake review identifies mannose-receptor-family-mediated collagen clearance and cites the primary in vivo/in vitro study using Mrc1 deficiency to test receptor-dependent collagen internalization.
limitations_preserved: Promote only receptor-mediated collagen uptake/clearance function; MRC1 and MRC2 cooperate in the in vivo assay, so no isolated purified binding or exclusive MRC1 mechanism is claimed.
